deadline.value: Application deadline is December 1 for fall matriculation; applications are reviewed until February 1.
deadline.quote: The application deadline is December 1st for students who wish to matriculate in the subsequent fall semester

also.quote: We will continue to review new applications until February 1

funding.value: Most students are supported on faculty research grants or by teaching assistantships.
funding.quote: The majority of students in the BME program will be supported on research contracts and grants obtained by their Faculty Advisors

entry_route.value: A bachelor's or higher in engineering, physical or biological sciences with a 3.2 GPA is required.
entry_route.quote: A bachelor’s degree or higher in engineering, physical, or biological sciences from an accredited 4-year college or university with a minimum cumulative GPA of 3.2 on a 4.0 scale

gre_subject.value: The department pages do not mention a GRE Subject test.

supervisor.value: The department pages do not say whether a supervisor must agree before admission.

notes: BME grad listing shows December 15 as priority for funding; the department page's December 1 date is used.
